prompt: gawk debugger eval command restricted statements
answer:
The gawk debugger’s `eval` command cannot execute statements containing:

- `exit`
- `getline`
- `next`
- `nextfile`
- `return`

Otherwise, it can evaluate AWK statements in the running program’s context, including assignments and function calls. ([GNU Awk User’s Guide](https://www.gnu.org.cach3.com/software/gawk/manual/html_node/Viewing-And-Changing-Data.html))
